title: On Dehn functions for infinite group presentations
summary: We study the behavior of Dehn functions of finitely presentable groups for presentations with finite generating sets and possibly infinite sets of defining relators. For the free abelian group $\mathbb Z^2$ of rank two on generators $a,b$, we prove that the infinite presentation $\langle a,b \mid [a^{2^k},b],\ k=0,1,2,\ldots\rangle$ has Dehn function of order $n\log n$. We also prove that, for every $0<α<2$, the group $\mathbb Z^2$ admits an infinite presentation on the same two generators whose Dehn function satisfies a global upper bound $δ(n) \le C n^α+ C$ and has matching $n_i^α$-order…
